Upgrade your everyday essentials with the stylish and practical Morucha RFID Blocking Bifold Wallet for Men. Expertly crafted from premium genuine top-grain leather, this wallet combines timeless design, smart organisation, and advanced RFID protection in one compact accessory.

Designed for daily use, the wallet offers a slim profile while still providing generous storage space for cards, cash, coins, and ID. The soft leather finish feels smooth in hand and naturally develops character over time, giving each wallet a unique premium look.

Genuine soft top-grain leather construction

products.description:
This multi flap over Morucha purse is quirky and fun and provides a multitude of secure areas to ensure your essentials are easily accessible and close to hand at all times. The flap-over section of this purse unveils five credit card slots, one ID slot, a pouch pocket, and a zipped section. However, additional slip/credit card slots can also be found inside the open compartment of this purse. Also housing four compartments for notes and recipes etc, there is also a coin pocket secured with a zip, to keep your loose change.

Also Crafted with a special lining to shield your credit and debit cards Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) chips from unwarranted electronic scanning theft.

Comes with a branded Morucha gift box

Purse dimensions: L: 7.5cm H: 11cm W: 3.5cm

products.description:
Material: Precious soft Nappa Cowhide leather wallet with a nice and natural texture. Really soft & comfortable to touch. 

Specifications:

Enjoy the peace of mind at home and abroad. This wallet features RFID blocking material that blocks high-frequency (13.56 MHz) RFID signals to protect your financial and personal information from external scanners.

There are 12 card slots, enough space for all your credit or debit cards.

1 Large compartment for cash/banknotes.

1 ID display window to hold your ID card or Driver License.

1 Pocket that can hold a mobile phone up to 6".

2 Slin Slip-in pouches for receipts/bills/train tickets or bus pass.

1 Full zip-around large pouch with a divider that is perfect for storing loose change/coins.

1 Internal zipped pocket for storing stamps, meeting your daily needs for use of both cards and cash.

Each ladies wallet comes in an attractive branded gift box, which makes it a perfect present for all special occasions.

Closure:  Clasp for the main compartment and a zipper for coin pocket.

Size: 18.5cm (Length) x 9.5cm (Height) x 3.5cm (Width).

Net Weight: 166 grams.
